title: Omitron Test Case 08 — 2D/3D conjunction probability disagreement
purpose: Mandatory model-escalation negative control. A 2D snapshot Pc result must not be treated as equivalent to the conjunction-integrated 3D-Nc result for this case.

source.source_notice: CDM fixture remains in the pinned NASA repository. This manifest references its immutable source blob and does not redistribute the file.

comparisons.invocation_summary: NASA test invokes Pc2D_Foster with HBR=20 m, tolerance=1e-8 and method='circle'.
comparisons.role: lower-fidelity escalation comparator; not the 3D reference

comparisons.invocation_summary: NASA test invokes Pc3D_Hall with HBR=20 m and default parameters from the pinned source revision.
comparisons.quantity: conjunction-integrated expected number of collisions Nc; for the isolated single conjunction NASA identifies Nc with Pc
comparisons.role: high-fidelity regression target for this fixture

derived_diagnostic.note: The numerical ratio is approximately 8.5e14 (nearly 15 orders of magnitude); use the exact expected values and tolerance above for assertions.

input parser version and state/covariance unit conversions
high-fidelity trajectory evaluations and all proposal-training/evaluation costs
